messages:
Noah: hi folks, quick onboarding question. I need to spin up a small EKS test cluster and link it to Redwood billing. I requested an AWS payer account link but got `AccessDenied` when creating a consolidated billing role. Anyone seen this?
Jenny: welcome Noah! For consolidated billing you need the payer account to add your AWS account as a linked account, and your IAM user needs `aws-portal:ViewBilling` in the master account or delegated permission. But most of the time infra does this as a service request.
Noah: ah ok. Can infra create the role? I don't have permissions in our org root.
Lina: @Noah yes, infra can. But we prefer adding the `eng-onboarding` AWS org unit as a linked account instead of one-off accounts. Which account id are you using?
Noah: 987654321098
Lina: noted. I'll open the billing ticket. For the role creation we usually ask for this policy snippet (we'll attach it to the ticket):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["aws-portal:ViewBilling", "aws-portal:ModifyBilling"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Noah: perfect, thanks. One tangential GCP question: I tried creating service account keys for CI in us-west2 but got a 403 mentioning `Constraint: iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation`. Is that an org policy?
Jenny: yep that's an org policy we enforce. SA key creation is disabled by default for security. Instead use workload identity federation or use short-lived keys provisioned by the infra team.
Noah: any doc on the accepted pattern?
Lina: add this to the onboarding checklist: we provide a GitHub Actions OIDC mapping for projects in `redwood-onboard-*`. File here: https://console.redwood.internal/onboard/oidc-guides (internal). I'll post the minimal steps: 1) create SA without key, 2) add Workload Identity Pool provider, 3) bind `roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser` to the GCP SA for the GitHub principal.
infra-bot: Note: project redwood-onboard-noah does not comply with org policy `iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation`. Automated key creation blocked.
Noah: ok switching to workload identity, thanks. Last thing: is it ok to pick `europe-west1` for the EKS NAT gateway tests? Finance sometimes blocks egress in EU for credits.
Lina: finance controls billing locations but region restrictions are enforced by org policies on GCP only; AWS regions typically allowed unless account-level SCP blocks. For EU data residency we route through a dedicated account. For your EKS tests, if you need EU infra ping `billing-team` to confirm billing and data residency.
billing-team: @Noah we can approve small test spend in europe-west1 for onboarding. Please include expected monthly cost estimate and team owner.
Noah: estimate: <$50/month for a 2-node t3.small test cluster. Owner: Noah (eng). Creating ticket now.
Jenny: quick tip: when you open the ticket include link to project and GH repo so infra can onboard faster. Welcome aboard :tada: 
Noah: thanks all! I'll follow up with the ticket and paste the ticket id here.
Noah: update: ticket #BILL-4123 created, infra assigned, will update when linked.
